const config = $json;

const start = config.start_date;
const end = config.end_date;


/*
 * =========================================================
 * EVENT-SCOUT — DISCOVERY
 * =========================================================
 *
 * Goal:
 * Discover as many relevant happenings as possible within
 * 100 km of Joutsa.
 *
 * Discovery favors RECALL.
 *
 * Later nodes handle:
 *   - exact date filtering
 *   - location resolution
 *   - 100 km radius filtering
 *   - deduplication
 */


/*
 * =========================================================
 * 1. LOCATIONS
 * =========================================================
 */

const locations = [
  'Joutsa',
  'Jyväskylä',
  'Lahti',
  'Mikkeli',
  'Jämsä',
  'Heinola',
  'Pieksämäki',
  'Keuruu',
  'Hartola',
  'Sysmä',
  'Luhanka',
  'Toivakka',
  'Korpilahti',
  'Säynätsalo',
  'Pertunmaa',
  'Hirvensalmi',
  'Kangasniemi',
  'Mäntyharju',
  'Äänekoski',
  'Suonenjoki',
];


/*
 * =========================================================
 * 2. GENERAL SEARCHES
 * =========================================================
 *
 * Major centres get 4 broad searches.
 *
 * Smaller locations get 2 broader searches. Their additional
 * coverage comes from regional/official/outdoor searches,
 * rather than wasting several Tavily queries on tiny towns.
 */

const majorCities = [
  'Jyväskylä',
  'Lahti',
  'Mikkeli',
  'Pieksämäki',
  'Jämsä',
  'Heinola',
];

const generalSearchesMajor = [
  {
    type: 'music',
    query: city =>
      `"${city}" Finland ` +
      `(keikat OR konsertti OR konsertit OR live-musiikki OR ` +
      `live music OR gigs OR concert OR concerts) ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    type: 'culture',
    query: city =>
      `"${city}" Finland ` +
      `(tapahtumat OR tapahtuma OR kulttuuri OR teatteri OR ` +
      `näyttely OR museo OR kirjallisuus) ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    type: 'small_events',
    query: city =>
      `"${city}" Finland ` +
      `(pub OR baari OR club OR klubi OR ravintola OR ` +
      `live OR keikka OR DJ OR stand-up OR comedy) ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    type: 'general_events',
    query: city =>
      `"${city}" Finland ` +
      `(festival OR festivaali OR markkinat OR messut OR ` +
      `ulkoilmatapahtuma OR puisto OR perhe OR luento OR ` +
      `keskustelu OR tapahtuma) ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },
];

const generalSearchesSmall = [
  {
    type: 'events',
    query: city =>
      `"${city}" Finland ` +
      `(tapahtumat OR keikat OR konsertit OR kulttuuri OR ` +
      `teatteri OR festivaali OR markkinat OR messut) ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    type: 'local_events',
    query: city =>
      `"${city}" Finland ` +
      `(pub OR baari OR ravintola OR klubi OR ` +
      `live OR tapahtuma OR ulkoilma OR puisto OR ` +
      `perhe OR kylä) ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },
];


/*
 * =========================================================
 * 3. EVENT AGGREGATORS
 * =========================================================
 */

const aggregatorCities = [
  'Jyväskylä',
  'Lahti',
  'Mikkeli',
  'Pieksämäki',
  'Jämsä',
  'Keuruu',
];

const aggregators = [
  {
    name: 'Keikkalista',
    domain: 'keikkalista.fi',
    keywords: 'keikat konsertit live musiikki',
  },

  {
    name: 'Keikat.live',
    domain: 'keikat.live',
    keywords: 'keikat konsertit tapahtumat',
  },

  {
    name: 'Mitä Menoa',
    domain: 'mitamenoa.fi',
    keywords: 'konsertit tapahtumat kulttuuri',
  },
];


/*
 * =========================================================
 * 4. STAND-UP / COMEDY
 * =========================================================
 */

const standupCities = [
  'Jyväskylä',
  'Lahti',
  'Mikkeli',
  'Pieksämäki',
  'Jämsä',
  'Heinola',
];

const standupSources = [
  {
    name: 'Nauramaan',
    domain: 'nauramaan.com',
  },

  {
    name: 'Stand Up Finland',
    domain: 'standup.fi',
  },
];


/*
 * =========================================================
 * 5. OFFICIAL / LOCAL CALENDARS
 * =========================================================
 */

const officialSources = [

  {
    city: 'Jyväskylä',
    name: 'Visit Jyväskylä',
    query:
      `site:visitjyvaskyla.fi ` +
      `Jyväskylä tapahtumat ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Jyväskylä',
    name: 'Jyväskylä city',
    query:
      `site:jkl.fi ` +
      `Jyväskylä tapahtumat kulttuuri ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Lahti',
    name: 'Visit Lahti',
    query:
      `site:visitlahti.fi ` +
      `Lahti tapahtumat ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Lahti',
    name: 'Sibeliustalo',
    query:
      `site:sibeliustalo.fi ` +
      `Lahti tapahtumat konsertti teatteri ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Mikkeli',
    name: 'Mikkeli city',
    query:
      `site:mikkeli.fi ` +
      `Mikkeli tapahtumat kulttuuri ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Mikkeli',
    name: 'Mikaeli',
    query:
      `site:mikaeli.fi ` +
      `Mikkeli tapahtumat konsertti ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Pieksämäki',
    name: 'Pieksämäki city',
    query:
      `site:pieksamaki.fi ` +
      `Pieksämäki tapahtumat ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Pieksämäki',
    name: 'Poleeni',
    query:
      `site:poleeni.fi ` +
      `Pieksämäki tapahtumat konsertti teatteri näyttely ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Keuruu',
    name: 'Keuruu',
    query:
      `site:keuruu.fi ` +
      `Keuruu tapahtumat musiikki kulttuuri ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Heinola',
    name: 'Heinola',
    query:
      `site:heinola.fi ` +
      `Heinola tapahtumat kulttuuri musiikki ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },

  {
    city: 'Jämsä',
    name: 'Himos',
    query:
      `site:himoslomat.fi ` +
      `Himos tapahtumat keikat festivaalit ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  },
];


/*
 * =========================================================
 * 6. VENUES
 * =========================================================
 *
 * High-value venues and small local places.
 *
 * These searches are important because small gigs are often
 * poorly represented by city-level searches.
 */

const venues = {

  'Jyväskylä': [
    'Tanssisali Lutakko',
    'Paviljonki',
    'Veturitallit',
    'Villa Rana',
    'Poppari',
    'RockNeck',
    'Musta Kynnys',
    'Revolution',
    'Club Escape',
    'Freetime',
    'London Jyväskylä',
    "Harry's Jyväskylä",
    'Hemingway’s Jyväskylä',
    'Lola Club Jyväskylä',
    'Parvi Jyväskylä',
    'Pub Aallonmurtaja',
    'Sohwi Jyväskylä',
    'Kulttuuritila Omenapuu',
    'Alakulttuuritalo Kramsu',
  ],

  'Lahti': [
    'Sibeliustalo',
    'Finlandia-klubi',
    'Möysän Musaklubi',
    'Ravintola Torvi',
    'VNUE Lahti',
    'Teatteri Vanha Juko',
    'Lahden kaupunginteatteri',
    'Malski',
    'Lahden Messukeskus',
  ],

  'Mikkeli': [
    'Mikaeli',
    'Kulttuuritalo Tempo',
    'Dom Mikkeli',
    'Olokorjaamo',
    'Gastropub Eino',
    'Wilhelm Public House',
    'Sport Pub Jälkipeli',
    'Bar & Bistro Route 431',
    'Mikkelin Teatteri',
  ],

  'Pieksämäki': [
    'Kulttuurikeskus Poleeni',
    'Pieksämäen Seurojentalo',
    'Pieksämäen Veturitallit',
  ],

  'Jämsä': [
    'Himos',
    'Himos Areena',
  ],

  'Keuruu': [
    'Keurusselkä Resort',
  ],
};


/*
 * =========================================================
 * 7. OUTDOOR / PUBLIC / COMMUNITY EVENTS
 * =========================================================
 *
 * This catches events without a conventional venue:
 *
 * - parks
 * - outdoor concerts
 * - markets
 * - fairs
 * - festivals
 * - town squares
 * - community events
 * - family events
 */

const outdoorCities = [
  'Joutsa',
  'Jyväskylä',
  'Jämsä',
  'Mikkeli',
  'Lahti',
  'Heinola',
  'Pieksämäki',
  'Keuruu',
  'Hartola',
  'Sysmä',
  'Luhanka',
  'Toivakka',
  'Korpilahti',
  'Säynätsalo',
  'Pertunmaa',
  'Hirvensalmi',
  'Kangasniemi',
  'Mäntyharju',
];


/*
 * =========================================================
 * BUILD QUERY LIST
 * =========================================================
 */

const queries = [];


/*
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 * A. GENERAL DISCOVERY
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 */

for (const city of majorCities) {

  for (const search of generalSearchesMajor) {

    queries.push({
      searchType: 'general',
      category: search.type,
      location: city,
      query: search.query(city),
    });
  }
}

for (const city of locations) {

  if (majorCities.includes(city)) {
    continue;
  }

  for (const search of generalSearchesSmall) {

    queries.push({
      searchType: 'general',
      category: search.type,
      location: city,
      query: search.query(city),
    });
  }
}


/*
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 * B. EVENT AGGREGATORS
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 */

for (const city of aggregatorCities) {

  for (const source of aggregators) {

    queries.push({
      searchType: 'event_source',
      category: 'events',
      location: city,
      source: source.name,

      query:
        `site:${source.domain} ` +
        `"${city}" ` +
        `(${source.keywords}) ` +
        `${start} ${end}`,
    });
  }
}


/*
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 * C. STAND-UP
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 */

for (const city of standupCities) {

  for (const source of standupSources) {

    queries.push({
      searchType: 'stand_up_source',
      category: 'stand_up',
      location: city,
      source: source.name,

      query:
        `site:${source.domain} ` +
        `"${city}" ` +
        `(stand-up OR standup OR comedy) ` +
        `${start} ${end}`,
    });
  }
}


/*
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 * D. OFFICIAL CALENDARS
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 */

for (const source of officialSources) {

  queries.push({
    searchType: 'official_calendar',
    category: 'cultural',
    location: source.city,
    source: source.name,
    query: source.query,
  });
}


/*
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 * E. VENUES
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 */

for (const [city, locationVenues] of Object.entries(venues)) {

  for (const venue of locationVenues) {

    queries.push({
      searchType: 'venue',
      category: 'venue_events',
      location: city,
      venue,

      query:
        `"${venue}" ` +
        `"${city}" ` +
        `(keikat OR konsertit OR tapahtumat OR ` +
        `live OR music OR stand-up OR comedy OR ` +
        `DJ OR club OR klubi) ` +
        `${start} ${end}`,
    });
  }
}


/*
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 * F. OUTDOOR / PUBLIC EVENTS
 * ---------------------------------------------------------
 */

for (const city of outdoorCities) {

  queries.push({
    searchType: 'outdoor',
    category: 'outdoor_events',
    location: city,

    query:
      `"${city}" ` +
      `(puisto OR ulkoilma OR ulkoilmatapahtuma OR ` +
      `ulkoilmakonsertti OR tori OR markkinat OR messut OR ` +
      `festivaali OR festival OR yleisötapahtuma OR ` +
      `kylätapahtuma OR perhetapahtuma) ` +
      `${start} ${end}`,
  });
}


/*
 * =========================================================
 * FINAL OUTPUT
 * =========================================================
 */

return queries.map(item => ({
  json: {
    ...item,
    start_date: start,
    end_date: end,
  },
}));
